[SWS_DM_01955] Configuration of a DTCs failed operation Cycles Tested Since
First Failed as extended data record
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
Di-
agnosticEdrDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticEdrDataProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_CYCLES_TESTED_SINCE_FIRST_FAILED
, the DM shall report the inter-
nal value of the current
Operation Cycles Tested Since First Failed
Counter
of the contextual DTC in the respective extended data record.
The length of this
internal data element
is one byte.
⌋
